name: agentcard-bundles
purpose: Staging. Builds one .agentcard per catalog agent that needs a package a phone's Python lacks, carrying pure-Python wheels and sibling files inside the card so it runs on a phone (Hive). Adds _agentcard and _agentcard_sha256 to those registry entries.

bundle_card.py.purpose: One agent.py in, one .agentcard out that carries its pure-Python needs.

build_bundles.py.purpose: Bundle every catalog agent that needs something extra; writes cards/ and index.json.

vendor/agentcard_core.py.purpose: The card format and its checks (copied from the Hive app).

vendor/pocket_host.py.purpose: The phone host's loader, used to read an agent's metadata (copied from the Hive app).

README.md.purpose: What this stack does and the rules it follows.
